an3.43:1.1: tayo’me bhikkhave atthavase sampassamānena alameva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
an3.43:1.3: yo dhammaṃ deseti, so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti ‘dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca.
an3.43:1.4: yo dhammaṃ suṇāti, so atthappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca.
an3.43:1.5: yo ceva dhammaṃ deseti, yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti, ubho atthapaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammappaṭisaṃvedino ca.
an3.43:1.6: ime kho bhikkhave tayo atthavase sampassamānena alameva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetunti.
